text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You might think you're comforting me,
but I don't need it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
What I need isn't a good run,
it's victory.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, without fail...
Ahead of everyone else—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I'll find what was missing,
and make it mine."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: In order to achieve results I can be proud of—
